\section{Emergent Classical GR}
Coarse-graining bead geometry yields curvature tensors:
\[
R_{abcd} \sim (\Delta g_{ab})_{\rm lattice},
\]
recovering Einstein's equations.

\section{Cosmology}
Energy density mapped to the spherical time-shell reproduces expansion. Heat-death 
concentrates energy into Planck-scale clusters that seed new cycles.
